usage: llama-fit-params [options]

  -m, --model <filename>              model path
  -c, --ctx-size <n>                  production context
  -ngl, --n-gpu-layers <n>           GPU layers
  -ncmoe, --n-cpu-moe <n>            CPU MoE layers
  -sm, --split-mode <mode>            GPU split mode
  -mg, --main-gpu <index>             main GPU
  -ts, --tensor-split <split>         tensor split
  -ot, --override-tensor <pattern>    tensor placement override
  --fit-target <MiB>                  memory fit target
  --fit-ctx <n>                       minimum fit context
  --no-kv-offload                     keep KV on CPU
  -fa, --flash-attn <on|off|auto>     flash attention
